messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated egress error rate observed in southamerica-east1 (sa-east1). Error ratio > 20% sustained for 5m. Triggering pager.

alice.m: ack. i'm taking lead. paging ben_g and carol_ops. linking the infra runbook.

ben_g: oncall here. seeing TLS handshake failures followed by 503s at the gateway egress tier. NAT gateways look healthy CPU wise, but we have TCP resets from remote peers.

carol_ops: context: small peering instability flagged earlier this week between our sa and eu peers. will try diversion plan.

dmitri.k: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:01Z svc-egress-1 sa-east1 conn_reset remote=10.23.45.67:443 status=ECONNRESET
2026-03-15T09:12:05Z svc-egress-2 sa-east1 http 503 backend=upstream-eu1 latency_ms=120
```
we're seeing backend timeouts when egress connects to eu-west4 and us-central1 upstreams.

ben_g: propose diverting new sessions away from sa-east1. suggestion: routing weight shift to sa-east2 and us-south1 for 30m window.

sre_lead: +1. keep diversion TTL low and enable fallback degraded mode (token-only, small payloads) for critical customers if needed.

alice.m: applying policy change now. control-plane call:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/redwood/v1/routing/update \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"sa-east1","action":"divert","targets":["sa-east2","us-south1"],"weight_shift":80}'
```

incident-bot: ACTION: routing update accepted. job_id=job-8a7f. monitoring hooks active.

carol_ops: metrics watch: sa-east1 egress error rate dropping 21% -> 6% within 6 minutes after diversion. some residual failures on sticky/cached sessions.

support_liaison: initial impact assessment: customers pinned to sa-east1 with streaming/long-poll sessions most affected. embedding-only customers largely unaffected.

alice.m: draft status page blurb for quick review:
```
Partial egress disruption impacting southamerica-east1 (sa-east1)
Status: Mitigating
Affected: Customers pinned to sa-east1; generation/streaming requests may see 5xx/timeouts.
Started: 2026-03-15 09:10 UTC
Mitigation: Traffic diverted to sa-east2 and us-south1; expect reduced errors within ~15 minutes. No data loss.
Next update: +30m or on change.
```

carol_ops: edit: add quick workaround: "If you continue to see failures, switch to sa-east2 or use region-agnostic endpoints." small clarifying tweak.

alice.m: updated. prepping to post to status.redwood.ai and queue customer emails.

support_liaison: customer email draft (concise):
```
Hi <CustomerName>,
We are investigating increased errors for traffic routed to our sa-east1 region starting at 09:10 UTC. Our ops team is diverting traffic to adjacent regions. If your workloads are pinned to sa-east1, please consider temporarily switching to sa-east2. We'll send a follow-up RCA.
Thanks, Redwood Support
```

dmitri.k: technical appendix for engineering customers (example override):
```
# temporary region override
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing/override -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"preferred_regions":["sa-east2"]}'
```

ben_g: traffic billing unaffected. expected latency increase for diverted flows ~40-60ms to us-south1. keeping autoscale enabled on sa-east2.

sre_lead: document mitigation steps in timeline. open postmortem focusing on peering stability and route priorities.

incident-bot: REMINDER: next oncall shift starts in ~45m. current oncall ben_g. plan handoff notes.

alice.m: handoff summary for next oncall:
- problem: intermittent TCP resets from upstream peers causing 503s/timeouts in sa-east1
- mitigation: shifted 80% traffic to sa-east2/us-south1 at 09:14 UTC (job-8a7f)
- status page posted at 09:18 UTC
- customer notifications queued and some sent at 09:22 UTC
- followups for next oncall: validate peering health, coordinate with cloud peering ops, expire stale KV caches if errors persist

support_liaison: 12 impacted customers with pinned sa-east1 endpoints notified at 09:22 UTC. monitoring for inbound replies.

carol_ops: reroute default TTL = 60m; will re-evaluate at 30m if error rate < 5% and peers stable.

ben_g: added watch: alert if TTFB p95 for diverted path > 300ms for 5m.

dmitri.k: quick runbook addition proposed:
```
if egress_error_rate(region) > 15%:
  - divert_traffic(region, targets=[nearest_secondary])
  - notify_support_and_post_status()
  - file ticket to peering-team
```

sre_lead: agreed. next steps: 1) engage peering engineers, 2) postmortem, 3) customer RCA within 48h. i'm holding oncall override until handoff complete.

oncall-next: i'll take over in ~40m. will monitor job-8a7f and the dashboards. DM any critical updates before handoff.

incident-bot: RESOLVE CHECKPOINT: sa-east1 egress error rate stable at 3.2% over last 10m, diversion reduced to 40% at 09:50 UTC to drain sessions. job-8a7f status=progress

alice.m: summary for postmortem: likely root cause = intermittent peering TCP resets from upstream provider affecting long-lived streaming sessions. mitigation = routing weight shifts + cache draining. followups: validate peering config, increase redundancy.

support_liaison: CS to proactively reach out to top 5 impacted customers with tailored logs & guidance.

sre_lead: closing the active pager. postmortem owners: carol_ops, dmitri.k. thanks all.

carol_ops: creating incident postmortem ticket; will attach timeline and artifacts.

oncall-next: acknowledged, will pick up and follow through. :thumbsup:
